sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 760. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Chipped Blade (nullifies effects that penetrate damage reduction or reflection when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 180% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 100% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Savior Element (increases all stats by 120%, increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack by 6, and increases Cost recovery speed by 10) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Water and Light Defense from Unison Damage +700
